meta.name: TCS New York City Marathon
meta.description:
This app will take you along the award-winning TCS New York City Marathon course. You will receive turn-by-turn directions and learn about points of interests as we start in Staten Island and end in Manhattan. This enjoyable scenic run shows you the best the city has to offer! 

Note: Some sections of this route my not be runnable outside of race day. 

Check out the RunGo route of the final 3 miles for a pre-race recon run: https://routes.rungoapp.com/route/9uYcCWWZKZ

Off to a great start!
Here is a fun fact. Fred Lebow, the founder of the New York City Marathon, was just trying to improve his stamina for tennis when he fell in love with running.
Fred Lebow organized his first race in Central Park. With 127 participants, only 1 was a woman, and only 55 completed the course! Unfortunately, the woman became ill and didn't cross the finish line.
The marathon has previously been cancelled in 2012 due to Hurricane Sandy.
